purpose: Teach: 市政/不正確/手引き/ライフサイクル/移設/定率/不払い/ファクス

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 市政との連携をしっかり取りましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we coordinate properly with city government on this.
lines.style: Calm, professional opening. Matter-of-fact tone. Steady pace. No rush—this is standard procedure but important. Leader's voice, not harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。不正確なデータは精査します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review the data for accuracy.
lines.style: Direct, capable. Slight nod in the voice on 'yes'—affirming without overthinking it. Quick, efficient. Straightforward commitment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新人研修の手引きを更新しましょう
lines.en: We should update the onboarding materials.
lines.style: Measured instruction, leader's tone. Matter-of-fact delivery. Slight emphasis on 'update'—this is a task to delegate. No urgency, just clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品ライフサイクルの管理表を作ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll create the product lifecycle tracking table.
lines.style: Responsive, taking note. Quick acknowledgment, then the commitment lands clearly. Efficient, capable. Kenji is tracking what to do next.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 支社の移設先を選定しましょう
lines.en: Let's settle on a location for the branch relocation.
lines.style: Clear directional tone. Professional, methodical. Slight pause before the task—this is a bigger decision. Decisive but open to input.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。定率減税の影響を試算します
lines.en: Yes. I'll calculate the impact of the tax deduction.
lines.style: Affirming quickly. Kenji is absorbing—this one has numbers attached. Slight focus in the voice. Competent, ready to execute.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 不払い案件のリストアップをしましょう
lines.en: Let's compile a list of outstanding payment issues.
lines.style: Direct, businesslike. Slight gravity—this is about money owed. Clear instruction. Professional tone, no drama.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外向けファクス送信ルールを整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll standardize the international fax transmission protocol.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment—this wraps up the list. Confident, capable. Kenji confirms the last task clearly. Professional close, no trailing.
